name: ChemCrow
one_liner: Couples an LLM planner with 18 deterministic cheminformatics, retrosynthesis, and safety verification tools.

loop.proposes: An LLM proposes multi-step synthesis plans, SMILES structures, and reaction queries.
loop.judged_by: Deterministic RDKit validators, RXN4Chemistry retrosynthesis engines, and controlled-substance safety checkers verify chemical validity and feasibility.
loop.steers: Tool outputs return to the model at each step; the validation of the robotic platform is iterated until the procedure is valid.

headline_result: Autonomously planned and executed wet-lab syntheses of an insect repellent, three organocatalysts, and a novel chromophore.
caveat: Synthesis success remains bounded by the coverage of the underlying retrosynthesis templates and reagent inventory.
beyond_harness_note: A controlled-chemical check and an explosive check screen a requested molecule before synthesis planning or execution; robotic synthesis executes routes, it does not verify them.
algorithmic_authority: RDKit, RXN4Chemistry retrosynthesis engine, and robotic wet-lab execution

sources.title: Augmenting large language models with chemistry tools (Nature Machine Intelligence, 2024)

verification.notes: Checked against Bran et al., Nature Machine Intelligence 6, 2024.
